User reported system error 'This operation was aborted (stopReason=error, model=cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3)' and context compaction, and asked whether it was caused by the consolidator; user said they waited a long time and stopped.
Assistant explained the abort was caused by the user pressing STOP (Paseo aborts the in-flight model call), not the consolidator; same signature as the earlier interrupt PoC with the sleeper agent.

Depth-2 test PASSED: worker b95b0d16 spawned its own scout 'd2-scout', which read /tmp/gap-test/case.txt and reported its two lines verbatim 'searchme lower' and 'SEARCHME upper', relayed by the worker prefixed with D2:.
Depth-3 blocking is not possible because the scout role only has read/grep/find/ls tools and no spawn_subagent, so depth control is enforced naturally by the allowlist.
Assistant verified depth-2 agent b95b0d16 showed updateCount 29 and currentModeId null.

Assistant gave final honest PoC verification summary: all main paths E2E pass, zero remaining duplicates (researcher merged, web-fetch/pi-web-access roles separated), coverage sufficient for real operation.

Assistant listed 5 untested areas: fetch_content video/YouTube frames (needs yt-dlp+ffmpeg), spawn guided-choice flow (needs user participation), pdf-reader on real scanned image PDFs (only tested synthetic PDF), user-side commands /om:compact and /md-log (never pressed), and web_search providers beyond exa/duckduckgo (perplexity, tavily).

Assistant noted the only real bug found today: OM INDEX.md says 'No topics yet' even though 8 topic files were generated at 12:43, because the consolidator does not refresh INDEX; flagged as cosmetic but worth fixing in observational-memory.
Assistant archived depth-2 worker agent b95b0d16-9c18-4ac3-8848-d88fe7bc16b3 successfully.

Assistant offered to fix the OM INDEX.md bug now or leave it for a later session, noting it touches observational-memory internals.

Assistant spawned worker agent 3108961a-a28d-4edf-97e7-35ebc690613c named model-audit to run the analyze-sessions skill and audit quality of the 5 models, with special suspicion on MiniMax-M3 whose scout-role agents today included 3ef0e69e, 151c7540, a20980ef, 345f36ad, 5cd46180.
web_search with provider tavily failed: 'Tavily API key not found', instructing to create /home/coder/.pi/web-search.json with tavilyApiKey or set TAVILY_API_KEY.
web_search with provider perplexity failed: 'Perplexity API key not found', instructing to set PERPLEXITY_API_KEY or add perplexityApiKey to /home/coder/.pi/web-search.json.

web_search with provider searxng failed: 'SearXNG base URL is invalid or missing', needing searxngBaseUrl or SEARXNG_BASE_URL; concluded only exa, duckduckgo, and jina providers are ready, others need keys or URLs.
fetch_content on YouTube video jNQXAC9IVRw failed with 'yt-dlp is not installed. Install with: brew install yt-dlp'.

pip3 install yt-dlp was blocked by PEP 668 (externally managed environment); assistant instead downloaded the standalone yt-dlp binary 2026.08.19 to ~/.local/bin and confirmed it, but found ffmpeg missing (NO_FFMPEG).
Downloading ffmpeg static from johnvansickle.com with ${ARCH}=x86_64 returned '404 Not Found'; correct arch name is amd64, so assistant redownloaded ffmpeg-release-amd64-static.tar.xz.

ffmpeg copy hit 'cp: not writing through dangling symlink /home/coder/.local/bin/ffprobe'; assistant removed the dangling symlink (which pointed to an old video-extract/node_modules/ffprobe-static binary) and installed ffmpeg 7.0.2-static and ffprobe 7.0.2-static to ~/.local/bin.
Retry of fetch_content YouTube frames on jNQXAC9IVRw failed: 'Timestamp 0:20 exceeds video duration (0:19)' (video duration correctly read), so assistant retried with timestamp 0:08 and 3 frames.
fetch_content YouTube frames retry failed with 'ffmpeg failed: ffmpeg version 7.0.2-static ...' with output truncated.
Manual yt-dlp of jNQXAC9IVRw warned: 'No supported JavaScript runtime could be found. Only deno is enabled by default; ... YouTube extraction without a JS runtime has been deprecated' (code 2).

Manual yt-dlp with --js-runtimes node succeeded, downloading me.mp4.webm (474489 bytes, format 395+251); the .webm already existed from the tool's earlier attempt, proving fetch_content's yt-dlp download worked and only its ffmpeg step failed.
Manual ffmpeg extraction of a frame at 8s from me.mp4.webm succeeded: /tmp/frame.jpg (13786 bytes, JPEG 320x240), confirming ffmpeg works on the downloaded file.
